program_summary.description: Builds an analysis-ready household file for a single interview month by merging the control file onto collected microdata, keeping households above a minimum usual-hours threshold, and computing a normalized person weight. Also sums weights and person counts by region into a review table.

macro_reference.name: hh_flat
macro_reference.purpose: Sorts and merges the control file D2 onto raw microdata D1, applies the usual-hours retention threshold, derives the person-weight rate, and writes WORK.O1 plus the by-region summary for interview month `p`.

variable_dictionary.name: HHID
variable_dictionary.label: Household identifier
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the merged input datasets (join key).

variable_dictionary.name: RGN
variable_dictionary.label: Census region code
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the merged input datasets (join key).

variable_dictionary.name: IMTH
variable_dictionary.label: Interview month YYYYMM
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through from the input file when populated; if blank, backfilled from the &p macro variable at call time.

variable_dictionary.name: PWGT
variable_dictionary.label: Person-level weight
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the raw microdata file D1.

variable_dictionary.name: PRXF
variable_dictionary.label: Proxy interview flag (Y/N)
variable_dictionary.derivation: carried through unchanged from the raw microdata file D1.

variable_dictionary.name: UHRS
variable_dictionary.label: Usual weekly hours worked
variable_dictionary.derivation: brought in from the control file D2 in the join.

variable_dictionary.name: NPER
variable_dictionary.label: Count of persons in household
variable_dictionary.derivation: brought in from the control file D2 in the join.

variable_dictionary.name: INCB
variable_dictionary.label: Reported income bracket code
variable_dictionary.derivation: brought in from the control file D2 in the join.

variable_dictionary.name: PWGTR
variable_dictionary.label: Person-level weight per 100 persons in household
variable_dictionary.derivation: computed as round(100*PWGT/NPER, 0.01) when NPER > 0, else set to missing.

variable_dictionary.name: RGN
variable_dictionary.label: Census region code
variable_dictionary.derivation: grouping variable carried through from the class statement (RGN).

variable_dictionary.name: PWGT
variable_dictionary.label: Person-level weight (sum across records)
variable_dictionary.derivation: computed via PROC SUMMARY as the sum of this variable across records sharing the same RGN (name unchanged from the input -- the `sum=;` output statement was not given explicit new names).

variable_dictionary.name: NPER
variable_dictionary.label: Count of persons in household (sum across records)
variable_dictionary.derivation: computed via PROC SUMMARY as the sum of this variable across records sharing the same RGN (name unchanged from the input -- the `sum=;` output statement was not given explicit new names).
